title: GoDaddy Dynamic DNS for Home Assistant

user.title: Set up GoDaddy Dynamic DNS for Home Assistant
user.description: Compares the Sophos WAN interface directly with the primary A record returned by the GoDaddy API. Local DNS is never queried.

data_description.additional_records: Add, edit, or delete one A record per line. Use NAME for the target domain, FQDN for common fully qualified records, or DOMAIN,NAME for explicit GoDaddy zones.
data_description.primary_record_name: Enter the host label. Use @ for the root domain.
data_description.verify_ssl: Keep enabled. For a Sophos-issued certificate, upload its CA and enter the path below.
data_description.firewall_ca_path: Optional PEM CA file, for example /ssl/sophos-ca.pem.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure GoDaddy Dynamic DNS for Home Assistant
reconfigure.description: Update API credentials, endpoints, records, and safety settings.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the firewall or GoDaddy API.
error.invalid_auth: GoDaddy rejected the API key or secret.
error.invalid_firewall_certificate: The firewall certificate is not trusted by Home Assistant. Configure the correct public certificate or provide the issuing CA certificate path.
error.invalid_records: The record list is invalid. Use one NAME, FQDN, or DOMAIN,NAME entry per line.
